confirmed: OpenAI announced on 14 Oct 2026 that gpt-4o-2024-08-06, gpt-4o-2024-11-20, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 and gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 will be removed from the API on 14 Jan 2027.
OpenAI's recommended replacement for all five is gpt-6-luna.
Fine-tuned versions of these models follow the same shutdown schedule as their base models.
gpt-6-luna does not support fine-tuning. From 6 Jan 2027, active existing customers can no longer create new fine-tuning jobs.
gpt-6-luna supports Chat Completions, Responses, Batch, structured outputs and function calling; on Chat Completions, function calling works only with reasoning_effort set to 'none'.
gpt-6-luna does not support the Assistants API or legacy /v1/completions.
OpenAI documents a shutdown_date field on GET /v1/models (not yet filled in for this batch; see the live checks).

On 23 Oct 2026 OpenAI shuts down gpt-4.1-nano and gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 (substitute gpt-5.6-luna); gpt-4o-2024-05-13, gpt-4, gpt-4-0613, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, gpt-4-1106-preview, o1, o1-2024-12-17, o3-mini and o3-mini-2025-01-31 (substitute gpt-5.6-sol); and gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-3.5-turbo-0125, o4-mini and o4-mini-2025-04-16 (substitute gpt-5.6-terra). Completions aliases on the same rows (gpt-3.5-turbo-completions, gpt-4-completions, gpt-4-0613-completions, gpt-4-turbo-completions) use the same substitutes.
o1-pro and o1-pro-2025-03-19 shut down on 23 Oct 2026. The documented substitute is gpt-5.6-sol with reasoning.mode set to pro, so the id is not swapped on its own.
gpt-image-1 shuts down on 23 Oct 2026. The documented substitutes are gpt-image-2.5-sunburst or gpt-image-2.5-flare. Image models and fine-tunes are not rewritten.

gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-terra model pages list Chat Completions, Responses and Batch as supported, and Assistants, legacy Completions and fine-tuning as not supported. The pages list reasoning.effort max; the live check rejects it. function_calling and structured_outputs are supported features. The pages do not state the Chat Completions parameter rules; those come from probes/probe_56-result.json.
gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct, babbage-002, davinci-002 and gpt-3.5-turbo-1106 shut down on 28 Sep 2026. The documented substitute for each is gpt-5.6-terra.

The 23 Jul 2026 shutdown includes computer-use-preview, computer-use-preview-2025-03-11, gpt-5-chat-latest, gpt-5-codex, gpt-5.1-chat-latest, gpt-5.1-codex, gpt-5.1-codex-max, gpt-5.1-codex-mini, gpt-5.2-codex, gpt-4o-search-preview-2025-03-11, gpt-4o-mini-search-preview-2025-03-11, gpt-audio-mini-2025-10-06, gpt-realtime-mini-2025-10-06, o3-deep-research, o3-deep-research-2025-06-26, o4-mini-deep-research and o4-mini-deep-research-2025-06-26. Substitutes are on each model entry.
gpt-4o-mini-transcribe-2025-03-20 shuts down on 20 Jan 2027. The documented substitute is gpt-4o-mini-transcribe-2025-12-15.
live: gpt-6-luna rejects `max_tokens` (400 unsupported_parameter, at every reasoning effort). Use `max_completion_tokens` (Chat Completions) or `max_output_tokens` (Responses). `max_completion_tokens` also works on gpt-4o-2024-08-06.

gpt-6-luna accepts temperature, top_p and logprobs only with reasoning_effort 'none'. At the default and 'low' effort, temperature is accepted only at 1, and top_p and logprobs are rejected. On the Responses API, temperature and top_p work with reasoning.effort 'none' and are rejected at the default effort.
Chat Completions + function tools on gpt-6-luna returns 400 unless reasoning_effort is 'none' ('low' and the default both fail). Function tools on the Responses API work at the default effort.
Undated aliases still resolve: gpt-4o -> gpt-4o-2024-08-06, gpt-4o-mini -> gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, gpt-4.1 -> gpt-4.1-2025-04-14, gpt-4.1-mini -> gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14.

GET /v1/models shows shutdown_date null for all nine GPT-4o / 4.1 ids and for gpt-6-luna; the 14 Jan 2027 date isn't in the API yet. Earlier batches are populated (e.g. gpt-4.1-nano and gpt-4o-2024-05-13 show 2026-10-23).

GPT-4o / GPT-4.1 models reject reasoning_effort (Chat: 'Unrecognized request argument', Responses: reasoning.effort unsupported), so adding reasoning_effort must ship in the same deploy as the model swap (live-tested 15 Oct 2026).

On Chat Completions, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-terra match gpt-6-luna (probes/probe_56-result.json, 16 Oct 2026): max_tokens is rejected at every probed effort (use max_completion_tokens); temperature other than 1, top_p and logprobs are rejected unless reasoning_effort is 'none', while temperature=1 is accepted at the default; function tools are rejected at every effort except 'none', including when reasoning_effort is omitted; reasoning_effort 'max' is rejected. Supported values are none, low, medium, high and xhigh.
unconfirmed: Whether the undated aliases (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1, gpt-4.1-mini) are retired or re-pointed on 14 Jan 2027. Today they resolve to dated snapshots that are on the shutdown list, so we treat them as affected.
Output quality, latency and cost on your own workload. Only a regression eval can show that.

Responses API behaviour for gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-terra (max_output_tokens, reasoning.effort, and tools without reasoning_effort none). probes/probe_56-result.json covers Chat Completions only, so those calls are flagged.
Whether the model pages' reasoning.effort value 'max' will start working. The API rejected it on 16 Oct 2026 for all three gpt-5.6 replacements.
